resources.string: Choose what the model writes during the first pass. The short format uses Horizon’s original instruction. The detailed format lets the model include more facts and works with automatic enrichment turned off.
Tell the model which details to keep and how to write the news text. This changes the article text and leaves the scoring criteria in their own prompt.
Original text sent to the model

Long publications are shortened before they are sent to the model. The Hovq preset uses 6,000 characters for scoring. The base Horizon preset uses 1,000. Both use 8,000 for enrichment and start at the beginning.
How much of the original text the model reads when it scores the publication and writes the news. Short publications are sent in full.
How much of the original text the model reads during automatic enrichment or when you tap More.
Enter a whole number from 500 to 100,000.
Enter an instruction of up to 12,000 characters.
When the publication exceeds the limit, take the text from the start or take excerpts from three parts. The same method applies to scoring and enrichment.
News text shows what the model wrote during the first pass. Classic view shows the original or enriched text. The score rationale can be shown separately in either mode.
Show why the model assigned this score in a separate block. This preference applies to the current server and is off by default.
The news text is unavailable. You can open the original publication.
The VPS has agent %1$s. This Hovq build requires %2$s. The installer backs up the database before installing the bundled version.
